digest.component_or_area: source code structure and documentation organization (src/rebar subsystems)
propositions: Approximately 2,033 lines of recoverable comments exist across 439 files in src/rebar, distributed across six subsystem shards (reconciler, plan_review+workflow, store/reducer, llm core, commands/CLI, root/services).

Comment blocks must be triaged and relocated to their proper taxonomy destination: history to tickets, architecture to ADRs, contracts to schema, with only concise just-in-time context remaining inline.

Self-referential prose explaining the 800-LOC module cap occupies 28 sites in the reconciler and artificially consumes the budget it documents, creating a self-referential cycle closed at outbound_differ.py:164.

Load-bearing comments documenting replay-compat invariants (_store/event_append.py, reducer/_processors.py, signing.py) and do-not-move blocks must be preserved verbatim and recorded in .joe-janitor/tools.md to prevent future re-flagging.

Six verified-stale comments exist that document live invariants (e.g. DC 8.17.1 HTTP 204 behavior, ACLI inverted flags, DET_CHECKS P1-P11 vs documented P1-P9) and must be corrected in place rather than deleted.

Eight sites carry the same four-paragraph idempotent-transform argument currently restated across multiple locations, which should be consolidated into a single ADR 0062 with inline citations replacing redundant prose.
